desc.zh-CN: 黛安娜释放技能后获得105%攻速加成，被转化为68点急速。配合纳什、巫妖等装备，常驻急速可达220点，实现无限QE超高频率爆发。 / 高额急速支撑下的QE连招频率极快，具有极强的瞬时爆发。

desc.en: Caitlyn already has the longest ADC range — with Scopier Weapons, you can auto across the screen.
desc.zh-CN: 女警本身就是攻击距离最远的ADC，在瞄准镜加持下，可以隔着一个屏幕打人

desc.en: Jeweled Gauntlet amps ability damage — armor-pen build is huge.
desc.zh-CN: 法爆可以增幅技能伤害，穿甲流伤害爆炸

desc.en: R steal triggers it, then casting the stolen R triggers it again.
desc.zh-CN: R偷可触发，再施放偷来的R可再次触发
desc.ja-JP: R スティールでトリガーされ、盗んだ Rをキャストすると再びトリガーされます。
desc.ko-KR: R을 훔치면 트리거되고, 훔친 R을 시전하면 다시 트리거됩니다.
desc.es-MX: El robo de R lo activa, y luego lanzar la R robada lo activa otra vez.
desc.zh-TW: 搶 R 時觸發一次，施放偷來的 R 再觸發一次。
desc.vi-VN: Cướp R kích hoạt nó, rồi tung R đã cướp kích hoạt thêm lần nữa.

desc.en: Vi W's % HP scales with AD. Fan the Hammer lets one auto stack two triple-ring procs — with AD items, autos are terrifying. Pure AD; push W to 30%+ HP for best results.
desc.zh-CN: 蔚的W三环百分比伤害随攻击力提升。连拨击锤使蔚的一次平A直接叠满两次三环，配合高攻击力装备，普攻爆发力极度恐怖。 / 走纯攻击流路线，将W百分比伤害堆叠至30%以上效果最佳。

desc.en: Stack armor pen, crit, and ability haste — chain Q + R into autos that quickly proc W's % HP burst for squishy deletes and tank chunks. Q can be flash-extended; R flight has CC immunity for dodging key CCs; E's AoE Excessive Force can snipe low-HP targets through walls.
desc.zh-CN: 以高穿甲、暴击与技能急速为核心，依靠Q技能强力冲拳和R技能天霸横空烈轰衔接普攻，快速触发W技能爆裂打击的百分比伤害，实现对脆皮的瞬杀和对坦克的重创。 / Q技能可配合闪现改变方位或延长距离；大招飞行期间具有不可阻挡效果，可用于规避敌方关键控制；利用E技能的范围伤害（透体之劲）可实现隔山打牛收割残血。

desc.en: Drop Hubris/Liandry's tradition — go crit + armor pen. Use Collector + IE + Jeweled Gauntlet from Mayhem hexes to max Q/R damage for instant kills. Skip Hubris — Viego doesn't get the kill credit after possessing. Better burst for instant kills vs long-range comps.
desc.zh-CN: 核心思路是放弃狂妄、焚天等传统装备，转而追求暴击和护甲穿透。利用收集者、无尽之刃配合极地大乱斗海克斯强化（如珠光护手），将Q技能和R技能的伤害最大化，实现瞬间收割。 / 不要出装备‘狂妄’，因为佛耶戈捡魂变身后参与击杀不会提供攻击力层数，收益较低。面对远程消耗型英雄（长手英雄）时，这套出装可以提供更高的爆发力以实现进场秒杀。

desc.en: Warwick's auto and Q heals both proc 5x Circle of Death; Q has 100% AP scaling + % damage. Cast Q at half HP for max heal = max CoD damage.
desc.zh-CN: 狼人的被动平A回血和Q技能均能触发5倍死亡之环伤害，Q技能不仅有100%AP加成，还有百分比伤害。 / 在半血时释放Q技能，回血量更高，触发的死亡之环伤害也更惊人。

desc.en: Tank champs with Vulnerable make Sunfire, Unending Despair, Thornmail, and Heartsteel item damage crit. Build Atma's for 50% crit and turn all your tank items into damage.
desc.zh-CN: 坦克英雄通过易损海克斯可以使日炎、无终恨意、反甲以及心之钢的装备伤害产生暴击。核心是通过阿塔玛之戟补齐50%暴击率，使全身肉装输出化。

desc.en: Mundo's E converts HP into huge AD — with stacked Heartsteel, you're both tanky and can one-shot squishies. Mundo's hex pool is exceptionally clean — top-tier tank hexes spawn often.
desc.zh-CN: 蒙多的E技能能将生命值转化为高额攻击力，配合超高层数的心之钢，在能抗的同时具备一刀秒脆皮的能力。 / 蒙多的海克斯池子非常干净，极其容易刷出顶级坦克海克斯。

desc.en: E rapidly stacks Slap Around.
desc.zh-CN: E速叠扇巴掌
desc.ja-JP: Eは 叩きまくれを急速にスタックします。
desc.ko-KR: E는 우당탕탕을 빠르게 쌓습니다.
desc.es-MX: La E acumula Bofetada rápidamente.
desc.zh-TW: E 可快速疊加扇巴掌。
desc.vi-VN: E cộng dồn Bạt Tai cực nhanh.

desc.en: Use Rabble Rousing with Zeri's passive — autos count as ability casts. Hex heals % max HP, so drop crit items for half-tank build; stack HP. Use Overlord's Bloodmail to convert HP into AD. Passive (not Q) counts as ability — every click heals; also works on minions and turrets.
desc.zh-CN: 核心思路是利用‘古式佳酿’海克斯，配合泽丽被动普攻被判定为技能施放的特性。由于该海克斯回血量基于最大生命值百分比，因此放弃传统暴击出装，转而选择堆叠生命值的半肉装，实现高频高额回血，配合‘霸王血铠’将生命值转化为攻击力。 / 泽丽的被动攻击（非Q技能）被视为技能，每次点击都能触发回血；攻击小兵和防御塔同样可以触发续航。

desc.en: Akali Q is high-frequency AoE — frequent Void Rift procs.
desc.zh-CN: 阿卡丽q频率高而且时范围伤害，可以高频触发虚空裂隙

desc.en: Lich Bane post-ability gives 50% AS, converted by Slow and Steady to AD, then converted to AP via Adapt.
desc.zh-CN: 巫妖之祸在释放技能后，会提供50%的攻速，可以被一板一眼转化为攻击力，再由物转法转为法强

desc.en: Use Ryze's passive AP-mana cross-scaling with specific items and hexes to loop mana/HP/AD conversions for infinite stat growth. Must take Adapt + Mind to Matter; Ryze lacks mobility, so don't sell boots without MS hexes; vs tanks build Void Staff; multiple Tear items stack slowly — pace your farm.
desc.zh-CN: 利用瑞兹被动技能中法术强度与最大法力值的互相加成关系，配合特定装备与海克斯符文将法力值、生命值、攻击力进行循环转化，实现数值的无限飞升。 / 必须优先选择“物理转魔法”和“由心及物”海克斯；瑞兹缺乏机动性，在没有足够移速海克斯前不要出售鞋子；若敌方坦克较多需补出虚空之杖；多件泪滴装备叠层较慢，需注意发育节奏。

desc.en: 100+ haste + Archmage = infinite Q.
desc.zh-CN: 100以上的cd配合大法师羁绊就可以无限q

desc.en: 20-second R cooldown.
desc.zh-CN: 20秒一个大

desc.en: Late-game 5000-HP shield — insane. Don't cast R — it reduces resists and shrinks the shield.
desc.zh-CN: 后期一个盾5000血，非常夸张 / 不要开大，开大会减少双抗，减少盾量

combos.slug: ivern-蛋白粉花剑奶盾流小菊

desc.en: Protein Shake + Statikk Shiv — tanky, heal, and shield all in one.
desc.zh-CN: 蛋白粉配合花剑，又肉又有奶又有盾

desc.en: When shielded, W directly triggers the heal.
desc.zh-CN: 有盾时W可直接触发回血
desc.ja-JP: シールドされている場合、Wは 回復を直接トリガーします。
desc.ko-KR: 보호되면 W는 회복을 직접 트리거합니다.
desc.es-MX: Cuando está protegido por un escudo, la W activa directamente la curación.
desc.zh-TW: 獲得護盾時，W 可直接觸發治療。
desc.vi-VN: Khi đang có khiên, W kích hoạt trực tiếp hiệu ứng hồi máu.

desc.en: In Mayhem, Sett's W stores up to 35% max HP in grit. W damage scales with grit cap and AD, so stack HP and AD — late, you one-shot. Forge: AD > HP > MS. E pulls both sides together; if both sides have at least one unit (minions count), it stuns — wait for full grit, EW guaranteed.
desc.zh-CN: 大乱斗中腕豪的w能存储的豪意值上限是生命值的35%。w伤害受豪意值上限和攻击力影响，因此核心思路就是不断堆高生命值和攻击力，后期达到一拳秒人的效果。锻体：攻击力>生命值>移速 / e技能是把两侧的单位撞到一起，如果两侧都至少拉到一个单位（包含小兵），可以产生眩晕，因此放技能时等豪意值满然后ew必中。

desc.en: Corki's E and W are high-frequency DoTs. After crit-damage changes, DoTs proc both Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerable — multiplicative amps. As a mixed-damage champ, Shadowflame and triple-amp logic fit perfectly. W's gattling fire trail and E reliably amplify crit damage.
desc.zh-CN: 核心思路是利用库奇E和W技能的高频率持续伤害特性。由于设计师调整了暴击伤害规则，持续性技能可以同时触发珠光护手和易损效果，并且两者的增伤以乘法计算。库奇作为混伤英雄，能完美契合影焰的法强加成和三次增伤逻辑。 / 库奇的W技能留下的路径火和E技能的机枪扫射都能稳定触发高额爆伤。

desc.en: Only ranged AD that should grab Triggered Inferno. Corki's W and E are sustained DoTs that ping-pong rank stacking. Pop E + W into a pile to instantly stack TI; build properly and one self-destruct caps the damage. Find a window: turn on E, W into face for instant stack + AoE detonation.
desc.zh-CN: 唯一推荐拿炼狱扳机的远程AD英雄。飞机的W和E都是持续伤害，可以来回互刷评分。开着E使用W冲进人群就能一瞬间叠满炼狱扳机，配合合理的出装，一波自爆就能把伤害拉满。 / 需要找准时机，开启E技能的同时用W技能直接骑脸以瞬间叠满并打出爆炸AOE。

desc.en: Void Rift deals magic damage, so it fits AP champs with high magic pen — % magic pen amplifies it, and Pridestalker's ability damage procs it many times.
desc.zh-CN: 因为虚空裂隙造成的是魔法伤害，因此非常适合法穿高的AP英雄，出百分比法穿可以提升裂隙的伤害，推推棒的技能伤害能多次触发虚空裂隙。

desc.en: Auto attacks benefit from Back To Basics.
desc.zh-CN: 普通攻击可吃到回归基本功加成
desc.ja-JP: 自動攻撃は 初志貫徹の恩恵を受けます。
desc.ko-KR: 자동 공격은 기본으로 돌아가기의 이점을 얻습니다.
desc.es-MX: Los ataques básicos se benefician de De Vuelta a lo Básico.
desc.zh-TW: 普攻可吃到基本功夫加成。
desc.vi-VN: Đánh thường được hưởng lợi từ Đơn Giản Hóa.

desc.en: Jeweled Gauntlet lets R crit — explosive damage.
desc.zh-CN: 法爆可以让大招暴击，伤害爆炸

desc.en: Play when hexes are absurd and the enemy is squishy — one punch, one kid.
desc.zh-CN: 海克斯特别胡并且对面很脆的时候可以玩，一拳一个小朋友。

desc.en: Blitz's R passive chains lightning between autos — Ethereal Weapon procs on that lightning, which procs the passive again in an infinite loop. Core is Dusk and Dawn for the extra on-hit (otherwise EW's CD breaks the chain). Must take Twin Flames — its bonus damage spawns firecrackers that proc R passive again, infinite knockup chain. NEVER cast R — once used, the passive ends. Use E off CD; EW procs E knockups; theoretically infinite knockups at 150+ haste.
desc.zh-CN: 机器人的大招被动是a一下敌人后会电一下，电一下会触发虚幻武器，虚幻武器又会触发被动达成无限循环，核心装备是黄昏与黎明，可以多触发一次攻击特效，不然再虚幻武器的冷却期间会断掉。必选双生火焰，被动造成伤害时，会发射爆竹，爆竹可以触发大招被动，实现无限击飞人传人现象 / 千万别放大招，大招释放后就没有被动效果了；e技能好了就开，虚幻武器会触发e技能的击飞，理论上技能急速再150以上就能实现无限击飞

desc.en: Full AP nuke for huge burst damage — good vs squishy comps.
desc.zh-CN: 全AP核弹流高额爆发伤害，适合打脆皮阵容

desc.en: Executioner refreshes Q after a participation kill — extremely fun, normal tank build.
desc.zh-CN: 裁决使参与击杀后刷新q技能，非常快乐，常规坦克出装

desc.en: Use new Mystic Punch's all-ability CDR with Runaan's split shots (also procs the hex), plus Dusk and Dawn double-proc — one auto reduces all CDs by 5s, enabling infinite Icathian Rain. Core is Mystic Punch + Runaan's combo; you have to actually hit.
desc.zh-CN: 利用新版【秘术冲拳】攻击特效减少全技能CD的机制，搭配【卢安娜的飓风】的分裂箭也能触发该特效，再配合【黄昏与黎明】双倍触发攻击特效，实现平A一次减少全技能5秒CD，从而达成无限释放【艾卡西亚暴雨】。 / 核心在于秘术冲拳与卢安娜的飓风的联动，必须攻击到目标才能刷新技能。

desc.en: Auto attacks benefit from Back To Basics.
desc.zh-CN: 普通攻击可吃到回归基本功加成
desc.ja-JP: 自動攻撃は 初志貫徹の恩恵を受けます。
desc.ko-KR: 자동 공격은 기본으로 돌아가기의 이점을 얻습니다.
desc.es-MX: Los ataques básicos se benefician de De Vuelta a lo Básico.
desc.zh-TW: 普攻可吃到基本功夫加成。
desc.vi-VN: Đánh thường được hưởng lợi từ Đơn Giản Hóa.

desc.en: Use Ethereal Weapon so abilities carry on-hit + Dusk and Dawn's Sheen damage — evolved W detonates 5 plasma stacks at long range. Must evolve W; vs tank teams swap Shadowflame for Void Staff; if you want to evolve E, grab Berserker's Greaves.
desc.zh-CN: 利用海克斯【虚幻武器】使技能附带攻击特效，配合【黄昏与黎明】的咒刃效果，使进化后的W技能在命中瞬间叠加并引爆5层被动电浆，实现超远程爆发。 / 必须完成W技能的进化；若敌方坦克英雄较多，建议将影焰替换为虚空之杖；若需进化E技能，可选择购买狂战士之靴。

desc.en: E's hit count isn't capped by Slow and Steady — attack-speed items give huge AD, and her passive AS also converts. Main E for damage. Time E around the AS lock; E and R do the heavy lifting.
desc.zh-CN: e技能的攻击次数不受一板一眼影响，出攻速装能获得大量攻击力，并且被动提供的攻速也会转为攻击力，主要靠e技能打伤害 / 掌握好e技能节奏，因为锁攻速的原因，主要靠e和r打伤害

desc.en: Passive stacks benefit from Shrink Engine — late-game attack speed easily exceeds 6.0.
desc.zh-CN: 被动层数能吃到叠角龙效果，后期攻速轻松达到6.0以上

desc.en: Bel'Veth's Q and W are AoE — multi-hits cut multiple CDs, making QWE basically zero-CD. Infinite QW knockup.
desc.zh-CN: 卑尔维斯的Q、W技能都是范围伤害，打中几个人就触发几次间cd，导致QWE技能几乎无冷却，可以实现无限QW击飞对手。

desc.en: With Adapt, 1 AD → 1.6 AP — prioritize AD in forge. Late, huge AP + huge HP makes R's execute threshold massive.
desc.zh-CN: 有物转法时，1点攻击力换1.6法强，锻体优先选攻击力，后期高法强+高血量，r的斩杀线很高

desc.en: Ascension combo.
desc.zh-CN: 登神长阶
desc.ja-JP: アセンションコンボ。
desc.ko-KR: 승천 콤보.
desc.es-MX: Combo de ascensión.
desc.zh-TW: 登神組合。
desc.vi-VN: Combo thăng thiên.

desc.en: Abilities can't trigger Q's empowered auto.
desc.zh-CN: 技能无法触发Q二段
desc.ja-JP: アビリティは Qの強化されたオートをトリガーできません。
desc.ko-KR: 능력은 Q의 증강된 자동을 발동시킬 수 없습니다.
desc.es-MX: Las habilidades no pueden activar el ataque básico potenciado por Q.
desc.zh-TW: 技能無法觸發 Q 的強化普攻。
desc.vi-VN: Kỹ năng không kích hoạt được đòn thường tăng cường của Q.

desc.en: Use R-stack HP + Heartsteel + Tank Engine for instant 10k+ HP and absurd survival/damage. Pure tank doesn't lack damage; for more damage add a magic Sunfire (Radiant Echoes).
desc.zh-CN: 利用大虫子大招层数提供的生命值，配合心之钢与坦克引擎海克斯，实现在短时间内生命值破万，并转化为极高的生存与输出能力。 / 纯肉出装也不缺伤害，如果追求更高伤害可以补一件魔抗日炎（璀璨回响）。

desc.en: Shrink Engine massively cuts R's CD. Stack Soul Eater for HP, and Triple-Stack Dragon bond × 2.5x means hex and champ stacks both ramp absurdly fast. R CD drops to ~10s. Triple-Stack Dragon means one feast = 3 stacks. Since E's % damage scales with R stacks, late damage is huge.
desc.zh-CN: 核心思路是利用“缩小引擎”提供的高额技能急速极大幅度缩短大招冷却时间。配合“吞噬灵魂”增加最大生命值，并通过“三叠角龙”羁绊将海克斯和英雄层数的叠加速度提升2.5倍，使科加斯的大招层数和海克斯层数在短时间内达到恐怖的高度。 / 在该体系下，大招冷却可缩短至10秒左右。配合三叠角龙羁绊，吃一个人可以叠加三层大招。由于科加斯的E技能百分比伤害随大招层数提升，后期伤害极高。

desc.en: Stack Shrink Engine — extreme MS. Don't evolve E — flight is too slow.
desc.zh-CN: 叠缩小引擎，移速非常快，不进化e，因为飞的太慢

desc.en: Kassadin's E and R are AoE — multi-hits proc multiple Void Rifts.
desc.zh-CN: 卡萨丁的ER都是范围伤害，打中多个人可以多次触发裂隙

desc.en: Kassadin E has a 90% slow — during the slow, he opens up 400+ MS gaps, locking in Don't Blink's 40% damage amp on the rest of his combo. Lead with E slow for max amp.
desc.zh-CN: 卡萨丁的E技能拥有高达90%的减速面板。在减速期间，卡萨丁可以瞬间拉开400点以上的移速差，使后续全套技能享受稳定的40%伤害增幅。 / 先手使用E技能减速是触发高额增伤的关键。

desc.en: R passive armor pen still works.
desc.zh-CN: R被动增加的物穿仍然生效
desc.ja-JP: Rパッシブアーマーペンはまだ機能します。
desc.ko-KR: R 패시브 아머 펜은 여전히 ​​작동합니다.
desc.es-MX: La penetración de armadura pasiva de la R sigue funcionando.
desc.zh-TW: R 被動的穿甲依然有效。
desc.vi-VN: Xuyên giáp nội tại của R vẫn hoạt động.

desc.en: Short range gets him kited — Scoped Weapons is mandatory.
desc.zh-CN: 手短容易被拉扯，有瞄准镜必拿

desc.en: Circle of Death converts heal into magic damage; Trynd Q has huge AP scaling — late Q hits 3000+ damage, deletes squishies. Stack AP and magic pen. Forge: AP > magic pen > MS. Stack fury before Q'ing; CoD has 1000 range, get close.
desc.zh-CN: 死亡之环可以把治疗量转换为魔法伤害，蛮王的Q可以吃到高额AP加成，后期一个Q能打3000多伤害，可以秒杀脆皮，核心思路是堆法强和法穿。锻体：法强>法穿>移速 / 叠满怒气再Q，死亡之环的攻击距离是1000码，需要注意靠近些再放Q。

desc.en: Trynd's Q has huge AP scaling (1.2x) plus heal scaling; Master of Duality's AP enables full-HP heals. Navori cuts Q CD — extreme survivability. Weave autos and abilities to constantly proc heals and keep MoD stacks up.
desc.zh-CN: 蛮王Q技能拥有极高的AP加成（1.2倍），配合回血加成，利用物法皆修叠出的法强可以实现一口满血。配合迅刃缩减Q的CD，生存能力极强。 / 利用平A和技能频繁触发回血，保持物法皆修的层数不掉。

desc.en: Use enormous AP and magic pen to amp spider-form Q's % damage. When damage is high enough, Elise triggers a special hidden 'true form' visual — a huge spider phantom. Visual works only on default, SKT T1, and Withered series skins — others just sparkle. Highly economy-dependent for AP/pen forge shards; in fights, target highest-HP tanks for max % damage effect.
desc.zh-CN: 核心思路是通过极高的法强加成和法穿属性，强化蜘蛛形态Q技能的百分比伤害。当伤害数值极高时，会触发特殊的‘武魂真身’隐藏特效，召唤巨大的蜘蛛虚影。 / 特效显示受建模影响，仅限原皮肤、SKT T1及魔女系列皮肤可见，其余皮肤仅有闪光特效；该流派极度依赖经济进行‘锻体’以刷取法强和法穿碎片；战斗中需优先寻找敌方血量最高的坦克目标以最大化百分比伤害特效。

desc.en: Pyke passive converts 14 HP into 1 AD; Goliath gives 35% HP and 15% AD, so 8 HP = 1 AD — late, 1000+ AD easy. R scales with both AD and lethality — full-HP squishies are in execute range.
desc.zh-CN: 派克被动是14点生命值转1点攻击力，歌利亚巨人提供35%生命值和15%攻击力，这样8点生命值就能转化1点攻击力，后期轻松1000攻击力。大招是攻击力穿甲双加成，脆皮满血就是斩杀线

desc.en: Sylas's auto is AoE — multi-target procs Juiced multiple times.
desc.zh-CN: 塞拉斯平a是范围伤害，可以多次触发注魔

desc.en: Sylas's post-cast empowered auto carries 125% AS, converted by Purist + Caster to 81 haste. Pace your auto chain to keep passive stacks up and you maintain 200+ haste permanently. Don't burn through all passive stacks at once — keep haste high.
desc.zh-CN: 塞拉斯施放技能后的强化平A附带125%的攻速加成，该攻速会被转化为81点技能急速。只要连招节奏得当，不快速打光被动，可常驻200点以上急速。 / 注意平A节奏，不要瞬间把被动层数全部消耗，以维持高急速状态。

desc.en: Darius's Ethereal Weapon and Blade Waltz don't stack bleed.
desc.zh-CN: 诺手的虚幻武器和利刃华尔兹不能叠血怒。

desc.en: R passive armor pen still works.
desc.zh-CN: R被动增加的物穿仍然生效
desc.ja-JP: Rパッシブアーマーペンはまだ機能します。
desc.ko-KR: R 패시브 아머 펜은 여전히 ​​작동합니다.
desc.es-MX: La penetración de armadura pasiva de la R sigue funcionando.
desc.zh-TW: R 被動的穿甲依然有效。
desc.vi-VN: Xuyên giáp nội tại của R vẫn hoạt động.

combos.slug: darius-回归基本功一刀流诺手

desc.en: Back to Basics gives huge AD — go full armor pen + crit and W deletes squishies.
desc.zh-CN: 利用回归基本功提供的高额攻击力加成，直接做穿甲暴击装，一个W秒脆皮

desc.en: Fire E into the pile.
desc.zh-CN: E往人多的地方放

desc.en: W and E have very short CDs and Archmage chains them — W reduces E, E reduces W — full-screen bullet hell. Needs 200+ haste; pair with haste hexes.
desc.zh-CN: 利用W和E技能极短的冷却时间配合大法师羁绊。W释放减E冷却，E释放减W冷却，实现全屏枪林弹雨。 / 此套路对技能急速要求极高，需达到200点以上。建议配合增加急速的海克斯。

desc.en: After picking Eureka, step back after casting E so Eureka triggers — otherwise it doesn't proc.
desc.zh-CN: 拿到老练狙神放E后需要往后走一步，否则触发不了老练狙神

desc.en: Runaan's + Mystic Punch — one auto reduces all CDs by 3.75s — basically infinite blind via Q.
desc.zh-CN: 配合飓风，一发平a可以减少3.75秒全技能冷却，极大缩减q技能冷却，实现无限致盲

desc.en: Stack CDR and plant shrooms everywhere.
desc.zh-CN: 堆cd，全图种蘑菇

desc.en: Q triggers healing 3 times, other abilities trigger it twice.
desc.zh-CN: Q触发三次回血，其他技能触发两次回血
desc.ja-JP: Qは治癒を 3 回トリガーし、他の スキルはそれを 2 回トリガーします。
desc.ko-KR: Q는 치유를 3번 유발하고, 다른 스킬은 치유를 두 번 유발합니다.
desc.es-MX: La Q activa la curación 3 veces; las demás habilidades la activan 2 veces.
desc.zh-TW: Q 觸發治療 3 次，其他技能觸發 2 次。
desc.vi-VN: Q kích hoạt hồi máu 3 lần, các kỹ năng khác kích hoạt 2 lần.

desc.en: [Hard to scale] Fiddle's Q deals % max-HP magic damage, doubled on feared targets. At 1467 AP, one fear+Q = 100% max HP. Forge: AD (with Adapt) > AP > magic pen. Hide in bush, one Q scares them dead.
desc.zh-CN: 【成型难度大】稻草人的Q可以造成敌人生命值百分比的魔法伤害，如果能恐惧到敌人伤害直接翻倍。在法强达到1467后一发恐惧Q就能造成100%的最大生命值魔法伤害。锻体：攻击力（有物转法时）>法强>法穿。 / 在草里猫着，一发Q吓死敌人。

desc.en: Fiddle's R is a sustained AoE — multiple Void Rift procs, devastating damage and visuals. Find a clean ult spot, fear lock + 99% Void Rift slow keeps everyone locked in the ult.
desc.zh-CN: 稻草人的大招也是典型的持续性范围AOE伤害，可以多段触发虚空裂隙。伤害极高，视觉效果震撼。 / 只要找个合适的位置跳大，利用被动的恐惧效果打出第一波控制，恐惧结束后对手还会受到虚空裂隙持续的99%减速，完全无法逃脱大招范围。

desc.en: Mini Gnar W has 100% AP scaling and 14% max-HP damage. Fan the Hammer applies 5 on-hits per auto + 2 triple-ring procs. With Dual Wield + Tap Dancer + Runaan's, one auto deletes most HP. One auto fills rage bar; mega form is less useful — manage your aggression timing.
desc.zh-CN: 小纳尔形态W技能有高达100%的AP加成和14%最大生命值百分比伤害。连拨击锤可以一发平a可以施加5次攻击特效，加上本身的平a可以一次触发2个三环被动。配合双刀流+接二连三，一发平a下去对方大半条命就没了。 / 一发平a就能叠满怒气，变大后没什么用，需要注意进攻节奏

desc.en: Forge: omnivamp > AS > armor pen > AD > MS.
desc.zh-CN: 锻体：全能吸血>攻速>物穿>攻击力>移速

desc.en: Weave autos between abilities — no more downtime.
desc.zh-CN: 技能穿插普攻，告别没有技能时的真空期

desc.en: Once CDR is high, infinite E permanently jails enemies.
desc.zh-CN: 技能cd上去之后，无限e让对面原地坐牢

combos.slug: veigar-超凡邪恶极致输出流小法

desc.en: Phenomenal Evil + Veigar passive + Shrink Engine — rapid AP stacking and damage.
desc.zh-CN: 超凡邪恶+小法被动+叠角龙，快速堆叠法强，提高自身伤害

desc.en: Passive attacks no longer refund energy. Never take this.
desc.zh-CN: 技能附带的被动不再回复能量，千万别拿
desc.ja-JP: パッシブ攻撃はエネルギーを払い戻さなくなりました。これは絶対に服用しないでください。
desc.ko-KR: 수동 공격은 더 이상 에너지를 반환하지 않습니다. 절대로 이것을 복용하지 마십시오.
desc.es-MX: Los ataques pasivos ya no devuelven energía. No lo elijas nunca.
desc.zh-TW: 被動攻擊不再返還能量。絕對不要選。
desc.vi-VN: Đòn đánh nội tại không còn hoàn năng lượng nữa. Đừng bao giờ chọn cái này.

desc.en: Gragas W gives AP-scaling % damage reduction with a 2.5s invuln after channel. At 2050 AP, 100% reduction. But you have to spend the empowered auto before recasting W, so there's a downtime gap — not perma. Forge: AD (with Adapt) > AP > HP > resists.
desc.zh-CN: 酒桶W能获得法强加成的百分比减伤，在W期间可获得持续2.5秒的无敌效果。在法强达到2050时即可达成100%减伤。但是因为释放W之后需要通过普攻释放掉加强攻击效果后才能再次释放W，存在较长的真空期，因此未能达到帝境。 / 锻体：攻击力（有物转法）>法强>生命值>抗性

desc.en: If enemy is squishy, Final City Transit deals more damage than Dive Bomber.
desc.zh-CN: 如果对面脆皮多的话，泥头车比俯冲轰炸能造成更多的伤害。

desc.en: Use Hubris's stacking AD with Bloodthirster's tenacity + omnivamp + Death's Dance's bleed-spread. Ambessa procs shields constantly, mitigating DD bleed — extreme dueler with huge tolerance.
desc.zh-CN: 核心思路是利用狂妄提供的成长攻击力，配合无穷饥渴的韧性与全能吸血，以及死亡之舞的流血缓释机制。由于安蓓萨能频繁触发护盾，可以有效抵消死舞的流血伤害，可以实现高机动性与高容错率的游龙玩法。

desc.en: Circle of Death deals 70% of heal as damage. Protein Shake amps shield/heal — Morde's W shield's heal-when-broken scales, dealing damage. Late, one W full-heal deletes squishies; W grants gray HP based on damage dealt, so with Executioner you can spam W forever. Never build Rift Maker or any omnivamp item — they override CoD damage. CoD deals magic damage — build magic pen. Enemy Serpent's Fang chunks your shield and damage.
desc.zh-CN: 死亡之环会造成治疗量70%的伤害，蛋白粉奶昔可以增加护盾值和奶量，铁男的w盾越厚恢复量越高，造成的伤害也越高，成型后一个W回血可以秒杀脆皮，W技能又可以根据造成的伤害获得白条，因此有裁决使后可以一直狂按W杀光敌人 / 不能出峡谷制造者和其他全能吸血类装备，会吞掉死亡之环的伤害，死亡之环造成的是魔法伤害，需要出法穿。如果敌方有巨蛇之牙，护盾量和伤害会大打折扣

desc.en: Q, E, and R are all AoE — high-frequency Void Rift procs.
desc.zh-CN: Q、E、R都是AOE伤害，可以高频触发裂隙

desc.en: [Hard to scale] Stack passive to boost E's execute threshold — at 3653 stacks, 100% HP execute.
desc.zh-CN: 【成型难度大】通过不断叠被动，提高E技能斩杀线，在3653层时，可以达成100%血量斩杀

combos.slug: aurelionsol-q技能无限刷新流大法师bug

desc.en: Aurelion Q's CD is 0s at level 9. Repeated taps proc Archmage's 30% CDR refund constantly, slashing E and R cooldowns for full-map damage. Even 0.1s breath procs the effect — quick Q-taps make long-CD abilities feel CD-less.
desc.zh-CN: 龙王达到9级后Q技能CD为0秒。不断短按Q技能可以频繁触发大法师的30%冷却返还，从而实现快速刷新E技能和R大招。 / 只需喷火0.1秒即可触发效果。通过快速连点Q，可以让其他长CD技能像无CD一样频繁释放。

desc.en: Only R benefits from the bonus. Skip.
desc.zh-CN: 只有R能吃到加成，勿拿
desc.ja-JP: ボーナスの恩恵を受けるのはRのみです。スキップ。
desc.ko-KR: R만이 보너스 혜택을 받습니다. 건너뛰다.
desc.es-MX: Sólo la R se beneficia del bonus. Sáltatelo.
desc.zh-TW: 只有 R 能吃到加成。略過。
desc.vi-VN: Chỉ R hưởng cộng dồn. Bỏ qua.

desc.en: Centered on Tank Engine + Cruelty. Rell's hex pool is extra clean, and combining them gives extreme CC + huge sustained damage for 1v5 plays. With both hexes, Rell becomes a different champion.
desc.zh-CN: 核心在于‘坦克引擎’与‘残忍’的配合。芮尔的海克斯池极其干净，通过这两个海克斯的联动，让芮尔在具备极强控制的同时，拥有惊人的持续伤害，达成1V5的战绩。 / 如果能同时拿到坦克引擎和残忍，芮尔将产生质变。

desc.en: CoD Nunu can deal massive damage to enemies via huge minion-Q heals. Avoid Rylai's — once you build it, Q on enemies stops dealing damage.
desc.zh-CN: 死亡之环的努努可以通过Q死小兵的大量回血对敌方造成巨额伤害。要注意死亡之环努努不能出时光杖，出了之后q敌方目标不会造成伤害。

desc.en: R is sustained AoE healing — pair with Circle of Death for huge damage.
desc.zh-CN: r技能持续性范围治疗，配合死亡之环可以打出高额伤害

desc.en: Use Marksmage to convert Thresh's infinite passive AP (via souls) into 75% bonus physical on autos. Combined with E passive's soul-based bonus magic damage and item on-hits, it's a triple-mixed-damage hit — melts squishies and tanks alike. Thresh's passive permanently gives AP and armor, so Marksmage scales endlessly. Stack souls + AS + AP.
desc.zh-CN: 核心思路是利用海克斯“神射法师”将锤石通过收集灵魂无限成长的法强，按75%比例转化为普攻额外物理伤害。配合锤石E技能被动基于灵魂层数提供的额外魔法伤害，以及装备的攻击特效，达成“三重混伤”效果，无论是面对脆皮还是坦克都能轻松融化。 / 锤石的被动能够永久提供法强与护甲，这使得神射法师的收益随比赛进程无限增长，完全没有后期乏力的短板。玩法核心是收集灵魂并堆叠攻速与法强。

desc.en: Since Conqueror heals at full HP too, Yuumi attached to a teammate constantly procs Conqueror damage on enemies — need an ally that can hold ground. CoD Yuumi stacks HP — regular support items are useless; Moonstone doubles a heal into two heals, mandatory.
desc.zh-CN: 由于狂徒在满血的时候也会造成回血效果，猫咪附身在队友身上可以一直触发狂徒效果对敌方造成伤害，切记需要站得住的队友。死亡之环猫咪要堆血量，所以常规辅助装对他来说没用，但是月石可以把一份回血变成两份，是必出装备。

desc.en: One auto = one passive stack.
desc.zh-CN: A一下即可叠一层被动
desc.ja-JP: 1 つの自動 = 1 つのパッシブ スタック。
desc.ko-KR: 자동 1개 = 패시브 스택 1개.
desc.es-MX: Un ataque básico = una capa pasiva.
desc.zh-TW: 一次普攻 = 一層被動。
desc.vi-VN: Một đòn đánh thường = một lớp nội tại.

desc.en: Cass W ground triggers Cruelty over a large sustained area — even enemies who walk in late retrigger it. R petrify enables huge burst. W+R combo dumps multiple Cruelty procs for cleanup.
desc.zh-CN: 蛇女的W技能缚地可以大范围持续触发残忍海克斯。即便对手后期走进W范围，也会重新触发。配合R技能石化，瞬间爆发极高。 / W+R连招可以瞬间打出多段残忍伤害，完成清场。

desc.en: After casting R, press R again to control the bear — Killing Time still triggers. Stack CDR for seamless bear chains and Killing Time uptime; stored damage explodes as true damage, huge amp.
desc.zh-CN: 大招释放后，按r控制熊，依然可以触发杀戮时间到了，堆高冷却可以让熊无缝衔接，全程挂着杀戮时间，存储伤害后爆炸能造成真实伤害，增伤效果非常强

desc.en: Ultimate Awakening gives small abilities 300 haste — Shyvana spams E at extreme frequency.
desc.zh-CN: 有终极唤醒后会给小技能提供300的技能急速，可以高频的释放e技能

desc.en: Use Shrink Engine for huge haste + Slap Around's Adaptive Force — perma QE CC stacking permanent AD. Open by searching Slap Around; with Triple-Stack Dragon synergy, 1000+ AD is easy and a single R deletes backliners.
desc.zh-CN: 依靠缩小引擎提供的超高技能急速，搭配扇巴掌提供的适应之力，一直用qe打控制无限成长攻击力 / 开局搜扇巴掌，有就可以玩，搭配高叠角龙羁绊层数可以轻松达到上千攻击力，后排一个大招即可秒杀

combos.slug: vladimir-左脚踩右脚万法强吸血鬼

desc.en: Stack Heartsteel for infinite HP growth, then convert via Overlord's Bloodmail, Riftmaker, and Vlad's passive into AD and AP, paired with Adapt and Tank Engine for explosive stats — late, AP easily hits 10000. Requires Adapt + Heartsteel — don't play without them. Once online, with Bloodmail and Rabadon's, two empowered Q's delete a 10k-HP Mundo.
desc.zh-CN: 用心之钢无限成长生命值，依托霸王血铠、制造者和吸血鬼被动将血量转化为攻击力和法强，搭配物转法和坦克引擎数值爆炸，法强轻松上万 / 这个流派刚需物转法和钢化你心，前两个海克斯没有这些建议玩别的流派。但是一旦成型极其强势，霸王血铠和帽子做出来即可两个红怒q一个万血蒙多

desc.en: Only E stacks it. Passive doesn't apply layers. Skip.
desc.zh-CN: 仅有E可叠，被动不施加层数
desc.ja-JP: Eのみスタックします。パッシブではレイヤーは適用されません。スキップ。
desc.ko-KR: E만 쌓을 수 있습니다. 패시브는 중첩를 적용하지 않습니다. 건너뛰다.
desc.es-MX: Sólo la E lo acumula. La pasiva no aplica capas. Sáltatelo.
desc.zh-TW: 只有 E 能疊加。被動不會疊層數。略過。
desc.vi-VN: Chỉ E cộng dồn được. Nội tại không tạo lớp. Bỏ qua.

desc.en: Combine Archmage with ~300 ability haste for infinite R.
desc.zh-CN: 通过大法师羁绊以及300左右的cd来达成无限大

desc.en: Void Rift ascends. Perfect synergy.
desc.zh-CN: 裂隙成神 / 虚空裂隙完美契合

desc.en: For Mejai's stack lineups — Heartsteel + Goliath/Tank Engine makes tongue reach across the screen, Q chunks stack-snipers half HP. Since stacks are plentiful, don't aggressively stack HP — Heartsteel is just for size.
desc.zh-CN: 用于打多丢子阵容，心之钢加歌莉娅/坦克引擎可使舌头达到一个屏幕长，一个Q可打丢子半血。 / 由于丢子太多，所以不用刻意钢血量，心之钢只用于加体型。

desc.en: Prismatic priority Dropkick, gold priority Overflow, silver priority Mind to Matter — assemble Archmage. Forge priority omnivamp + CDR. Easy to play; watch your mana late.
desc.zh-CN:
彩色首选飞身踢，金色首选溢流，银色首选由心及物，凑大法师羁绊
锻体首选全吸➕cd  / 这套海克斯有手就能玩，注意后期蓝量

desc.ja-JP: パッシブは エーテル武器をトリガーせず、Eはパッシブをスタックしません。決してこれを選ばないでください。
desc.ko-KR: 패시브는 환영 무기을 트리거하지 않으며 E는 패시브를 스택하지 않습니다. 이건 절대 선택하지 마세요.
desc.es-MX: La pasiva no activa Arma Etérea y la E no acumula pasiva. Nunca lo elijas.
desc.zh-TW: 被動無法觸發幻影武器，E 也無法疊被動。千萬別選。
desc.vi-VN: Nội tại không kích hoạt Vũ Khí Siêu Nhiên và E không cộng dồn nội tại. Đừng bao giờ chọn.

desc.en: Huge MS and heal/shield uptime.
desc.zh-CN: 高额移速和回血护盾

desc.en: Ethereal Weapon keyboard-mash to proc Mystic Punch — autopilot. Take it if offered.
desc.zh-CN: 虚幻武器滚键盘触发秘书冲拳 / 拿到就是给了

desc.en: Huge AP — Q from afar, instant W up close, will the yellow card and the yellow card will come.
desc.zh-CN: 高额法强 / 远处放q技能，贴脸时秒切W，心想黄牌就是黄牌

desc.en: E with crit → instant triple-ring. Long CD — pick your engage; vs shield comps, build shield-shred.

desc.zh-CN: W回血量基于护盾量，可吃到两次蛋白粉加成，配合死亡之环秒人
desc.ja-JP: Wは シールド 量に基づいて回復するため、プロテインシェイクは 2 回適用されます。ワンショットの場合は 死者の集いと組み合わせます。
desc.ko-KR: W는 보호막 양을 기준으로 치료하므로 프로틴 음료이 두 번 적용됩니다. 원샷을 위해 죽음의 순환과 페어링하세요.
desc.es-MX: La W cura según el tamaño del escudo, así que Batido de Proteínas se aplica dos veces. Combínalo con Círculo de la Muerte para one-shots.
desc.zh-TW: W 的回血基於護盾量，因此蛋白飲會生效兩次。搭配死亡循環直接秒殺。
desc.vi-VN: W hồi máu dựa trên lượng khiên, nên Tăng Cường Thể Lực kích hoạt hai lần. Kết hợp với Vòng Tròn Tử Thần để one-shot.

desc.zh-CN: 雪球进去秒人

combos.slug: yuumi-猫咪拿到这套必须s强度

desc.en: 1. Best in premades with comms. 2. Need a tank teammate who can hold ground. 3. Grab Tank Engine + Circle of Death. 4. Build magic pen if possible — huge late damage. Theoretically die once, recall, buy Conqueror — then ride teammates forever. Yuumi mechanic: attach to a recalling ally at fountain to follow them and skip refunds for the next hex. Watch tower dives — let teammate take aggro first or CoD draws turret aggro and Conqueror heal breaks.
desc.zh-CN:
1.适合开黑玩，有队友沟通
2.队友有一个坦克，能扛得住的
3.拿到坦克引擎和死亡之环
4.能出法穿就出法穿，后期伤害巨高 / 理论上只需要死一次，回家出狂徒，就能一直挂队友，猫咪有个机制，你如果在泉水上队友身，跟着队友传出去，可以不回泉水选下一个海克斯，需要注意越塔时候让队友先抗，否则容易触发死亡之环抗塔，失去狂徒回血效果

desc.en: Hubris stacks too slowly early; pair with Collector for pure lifesteal — works for sneaky players. Hide early until IE comes online; pre-level-6 use kills to ramp, otherwise late falls off.
desc.zh-CN: 狂妄前期叠太慢，狂妄收集者纯吸血，想打出作用又玩得阴暗的可以试试 / 前期自闭憋到无尽出来就有作用了，六级前有头就K，不然后期没作用

desc.en: Triple-Stack Dragon perma-stacks Thresh passive — great vs melee comps; easy 500 armor.
desc.zh-CN: 叠角龙无限叠锤石被动，适合对面菜刀队阵容，轻松500护甲

desc.en: Archmage bond, W in then QRQE — reliable squishy deletes. Damage mainly from multi-Q passive marks. Once Archmage is up, swap to other damage amps. (Archmage is a massive boost for LeBlanc in real economy.) Once cooldowns are up, harass; squishies get bursted fast.
desc.zh-CN: 大法师羁绊，W过去QRQE，稳定融化脆皮，主要靠多打Q的印记打伤害，大法师羁绊有了就可以选择其他增伤符文。（大法师算是真金白银局能给妖姬非常大提升的羁绊） / 等技能CD好就上去骚扰，打到脆皮的话能稳定快速出伤
